purpose: A titled group of SettingsRow on a settings page; the page stacks sections, and the section carries no outer spacing.

notFor.case: A group that opens and closes.
Grouping content on a contained surface.

Default.visual: Title in Content/primary (Type/heading-2xs), description in Content/secondary (Type/body-md).

a11y.role: None stated; the title is an h2 and labels the section (aria-labelledby).
notes: The title is an h2, so the page stays navigable by headings.

openQuestions: Built Figma-first under exception STG-001 (governance/exceptions.yaml, review by 2026-12-02): the stories still need the owner's approval. Is the Figma set final for this intent?
The heading level is fixed at h2. What happens when a settings page sits under another h2?
